name: 林鈞陶
objective:
此課程主要是含蓋無線通訊基頻訊號處理的理論基礎與系統架構，大部分的課程內容會以目前熱門的多輸入多輸出 (MIMO) 傳輸為背景而進行探討。

This course provides the fundamental theories and architectures for baseband wireless communications. Much attention will be focused on the multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) transmission.

Week 10: Spatial Multiplexing and Receiver Design.
Week 11: Spatial Multiplexing and Receiver Design.
Week 12: Space-Time Coding.
Week 13: Space-Time Coding.
Week 14: Midterm II.
Week 15-18: Other MIMO Transceivers (Optional) and Final Project.
